intro: Jitters is a trembling, reclusive human hiding out among the ruins of Raven Hill in western Duskwood. Consumed by constant paranoia and fear, he survives alone on Duskwood's perilous western edge, relying on passing adventurers for assistance while watching the encroaching shadows.

Found shivering amid the dilapidated houses of Raven Hill, Jitters lives in constant terror of the predators stalking Duskwood's western trails. He relies on passing adventurers for simple sustenance, desperate for food while keeping a frantic eye on the encroaching shadows. His skittish mannerisms and uncanny reflex for leaping clear of sudden danger earned him his moniker long ago, but his frantic paranoia is born from firsthand encounters with horrific horrors.
